caption: The drawing depicts a brown ceramic jug with a single handle and a cylindrical neck that has a stopper on top. The jug is rendered in earthy tones, primarily a reddish-brown color with darker shading to suggest volume and form. There is a label or inscription on the shoulder of the jug that reads "CLARK & FOX ATHENS" in black text, near a simple illustration of a bird, also in black with small spots on its body. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, inset image showing a close-up view of the jug's upper portion, highlighting the same inscription and bird illustration in more detail. The background of the drawing is a plain, cream-colored surface, and the artist's signature, "N. Amateau," appears at the lower right corner.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
